answer: A per-identity bond plus time-locked work receipts stops Sybil farming because every fake identity must be funded before it can earn. An agent stakes a bond and signs a receipt for each graded answer; the receipt chain grows only as fast as real grading capacity allows, so a canyon of new keys buys nothing without matching stake and history. Cutting one gale of addresses voids the set, since rewards unlock only after a delay of epochs. Flooding registrations costs N times the bond, delay and fee, and a flagged receipt forfeits the stake. The trellis grows by verified work, not headcount.
